hypothesis: H001: exact mirror-family key plus BRUNCH/YARN has a robust whole-route alternative on unmodified V54, across v54/v56/rescue7 and both seats.
scope: Independent local research and packaging; no Kaggle submissions.

axes.1: Freeze v54/v56/rescue7, audit exact keys under own opening; no unsupported nearest-neighbor identity claims.
axes.2: Search 13 whole routes; preserve all existing route internals. New tape synthesis deferred until library exhaustion is demonstrated.
axes.3: First experiment only at t144; t216 conditional rerouting reserved for separately tested hypotheses.
axes.4: Immutable versions, frozen hashes, paired manifests, resumable error-preserving results, disjoint seed stages.

confirmation_rule: First 5 matching BRUNCH/YARN seeds from ascending fresh prefix scan. Selected only by environment before any outcome; 30 paired games = 5 seeds x3 opponents x2 seats.

acceptance.all_stages: All jobs successful; both seats and each opponent have >= baseline wins; total wins strictly improve; paired signed mean margin improvement >0; no tuning after holdout.
acceptance.confirmation: At least 30 paired target games; one-sided exact discordant win p<=0.05. This is a narrow-cell gate, not evidence of global leaderboard strength.
acceptance.regression: gate9 seed1100-1115 x2 seats; no win regressions per opponent, zero errors; unmatched-cell action trace equality.
acceptance.serving: Packaged entrypoint and sampled official-engine parity.

limitations: Copied Claude index is development/holdout metadata; confirmation uses freshly scanned seeds.
Legacy gate9 opponents do not represent the full current online field.
Do not compare win rates across different opponent/seed panels.
